title: Journey Home:
title_short: Day 1 AM · Why I'm in a bathroom
headline: He films in a public bathroom, because people without a home have no bathroom, and no one in power sees them.
story: Dwayne is not on camera. On purpose. The camera walks through a public bathroom while he says: people without a home have no bathroom, and they become invisible. Churches and nonprofits have helped for decades, with no support from the people in power.
Then the turn: “we're ready to let the truth be seen.” That is the hopeful line. End on the ask: comment “I'm in”. Plain, calm, honest. Never angry, never sad.
